searchText: A huge share (30%?) of world pop is affected by it so I don’t think it’s that dangerous or a good example. Perhaps you’ve meant some other std. Let me clarify, Toly on any project's cap table is the equivalent of genital herpes (HSV Type 2). Multicoin is HIV. Gotcha. Thanks for clarifying!
